plain_text:
Select an organized, enthusiastic, and creative person to coordinate the paper
use reduction activities. The coordinator should be someone who communicates
well with coworkers and can dedicate time in the immediate future to establish
an effective program. It need not be a full-time position or effort. The coordinator
must also have the authority or ability to make the program happen.
semantic_text: Select an organized, enthusiastic, and creative person to coordinate the paper use reduction activities. The coordinator should be someone who communicates well with coworkers and can dedicate time in the immediate future to establish an effective program. It need not be a full-time position or effort. The coordinator must also have the authority or ability to make the program happen.

plain_text:
The coordinator should form a committee with representatives from key
departments—such as purchasing, receiving, marketing, administration, and
maintenance—to discuss how to best implement paper use reduction at your
workplace. Include fellow employees in the development of the program, including
department heads and support staff. The broader the base of support and
enthusiasm, the greater will be the chances of cooperation and success.
semantic_text: The coordinator should form a committee with representatives from key departments—such as purchasing, receiving, marketing, administration, and maintenance—to discuss how to best implement paper use reduction at your workplace. Include fellow employees in the development of the program, including department heads and support staff. The broader the base of support and enthusiasm, the greater will be the chances of cooperation and success.

plain_text:
□ Develop a plan. Start small—tackle one thing at a time, but create a
process that will allow you to expand your efforts in phases.
semantic_text: □ Develop a plan. Start small—tackle one thing at a time, but create a process that will allow you to expand your efforts in phases.

plain_text:
□ Track and evaluate your efforts. An important part of securing both
management and organizational support is to keep track of and
evaluate the results of your efforts.
semantic_text: □ Track and evaluate your efforts. An important part of securing both management and organizational support is to keep track of and evaluate the results of your efforts.

plain_text:
• What if this single-sided copy could be reused?
• What if this weekly report could be sent electronically instead
of printed for distribution to staff?

• What if this company policy document could be accessed
online so it wouldn’t have to be printed every time it changes,
thus preventing the waste in the first place?

• What if this catalog could be obtained on a compact disc
or online instead of as a printed book?

plain_text:
□ Keep non-team members involved. Share your questions and the Green
Team's progress with the rest of the organization to generate more good ideas.
semantic_text: □ Keep non-team members involved. Share your questions and the Green Team's progress with the rest of the organization to generate more good ideas.

plain_text:
Present your cost and benefit findings to senior management. Get management
on board with your plan to rethink and reduce paper use in the office. Refer to
the Sample Internal Memo: Developing a Smart Paper Plan in the Appendix for an
example management “buy-in” memo.
semantic_text: Present your cost and benefit findings to senior management. Get management on board with your plan to rethink and reduce paper use in the office. Refer to the Sample Internal Memo: Developing a Smart Paper Plan in the Appendix for an example management “buy-in” memo.

plain_text:
□ Evaluate your current
consumption to see which paper
uses to target. Use the Office
Paper Use Questionnaire (in
the Appendix) to assess current
practices in your office and
find out where there's room to
improve.
semantic_text: □ Evaluate your current consumption to see which paper uses to target. Use the Office Paper Use Questionnaire (in the Appendix) to assess current practices in your office and find out where there's room to improve.

plain_text:
□ Survey your organization’s
use of both printer/copier and
professional print materials. Look
at paper use, paper recycling, and
paper purchasing practices.
semantic_text: □ Survey your organization’s use of both printer/copier and professional print materials. Look at paper use, paper recycling, and paper purchasing practices.

plain_text:
□ Pull together key staff members
from each department. This will
help you make effective change
and gain officewide support.
semantic_text: □ Pull together key staff members from each department. This will help you make effective change and gain officewide support.

plain_text:
□ Refer to NRDC’s Paper Use
Reduction Worksheet in the
Appendix. Start with simple paper
reduction strategies like many on
this spreadsheet that don’t need
any budget or approval from the
top. Edit the spreadsheet and add
your own strategies to create a
customized plan for your office.
semantic_text: □ Refer to NRDC’s Paper Use Reduction Worksheet in the Appendix. Start with simple paper reduction strategies like many on this spreadsheet that don’t need any budget or approval from the top. Edit the spreadsheet and add your own strategies to create a customized plan for your office.
